verdict.rationale: Opting out of telemetry and usage tracking is a fair question for an online legal-services platform with user accounts and dashboards, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of tracking opt-outs, cookie controls, or analytics preferences. The registered-agent address privacy feature (legalzoom-docs-7) is an adjacent privacy feature about public records, not telemetry, so it earns no credit.
